provider_receipt.summary: Completion is unsupported. Named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:15-25 cannot deserialize the documented human_knowledge.v1 frontmatter: required contract fields such as authority, source_type, owner, privacy, review_required, supersession, and affected paths/agents are absent, while confidence incorrectly requires u8 although the contract specifies low|medium|high. (2) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store only serializes and discards each record, so scan_vault provides no durable Mnemosyne persistence or provenance despite the stated interface. (3) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently drops WalkDir errors, allowing incomplete vault scans to report success. (4) src/lib.rs:184-192 accepts absolute and parent-traversal wikilinks without enforcing vault containment, and can return paths outside the private vault. (5) src/lib.rs:152-158 does not anchor frontmatter at the start of the file, so body text containing delimiter pairs can be misclassified as metadata. Existing tests cover only basic links and a missing path; they do not exercise the documented ingestion contract, privacy containment, durable persistence, malformed input, or traversal errors. The supplied receipts establish clean-tree state and successful closure lineage but provide no behavioral verification resolving these defects.
